posts.title: Reverse-Engineering a Legacy Nooie Camera
posts.description: I bought a Nooie Cam 360 ( IPC100B ) five years ago when my son was a baby. For five years, it has been stuck behind the vendor’s Android app: useful for checking in from a phone, useless for everything else.
